newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norway shares end higher on U.S. CPI data.
newsitem.headline: Norway shares end higher on U.S. CPI data.

text.p: Norwegian shares hit a life high on Tuesday after the release of a smaller than forecast rise in the U.S. December CPI data, dealers said.
Oslo's Total share index finished 0.25 percent higher at 1,015.36 points, a record close. Turnover was heavy at 1.2 billion crowns.
The index at first dropped to about 1,006 points partly because of negative sentiments on export-oriented companies due to the strong crown, dealers said.
It picked up following the release of the U.S. inflation figures in the afternoon.
Industrial giant Norsk Hydro was the most traded share at 153 million crowns, rising 0.70 percent to 361.50 crowns.
Saga Petroleum's B share had a turnover of 65 million crowns, climbing 0.43 percent to 117.50 crowns.
